official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Plan an outdoor garden or yard to scale and explore the layout in 3D.

Describe your yard's dimensions and the features you want. 3D Garden Designer creates a saved layout with lawns, planting beds, paths, trees and garden features, then returns links to the editable plan and 3D walk. Estimated dimensions are marked approximate.

Move or resize labelled items, change materials, undo edits and copy a garden to compare another layout. Saved gardens belong to your account. Optional view-only sharing lets anyone with the active link see the current title, plan, 3D walk and notes.

The realistic-picture tool opens the saved garden's website page, where you choose a viewpoint and request a visualisation. The tool itself does not generate an image.

An account and sign-in are required. The initial version models flat ground. Plans are design aids, not land surveys or structural, drainage, botanical or safety advice.
